description: This Java class defines a custom runtime exception UnsupportedCommandException, used to signal that an unsupported or invalid command was encountered in the platform. The class extends RuntimeException, has a field to store the command name, and provides constructors and a getter method.

classes.name: UnsupportedCommandException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception thrown when an unsupported command is attempted to be processed by the platform. It includes constructors to instantiate the exception with the command name and an optional message, and a getter for the command name.

methods.name: UnsupportedCommandException(String unsupportedCommandName)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the name of the unsupported command.

methods.name: UnsupportedCommandException(String unsupportedCommandName, String message)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with the name of the unsupported command and a custom message.

methods.name: getUnsupportedCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the unsupported command that caused this exception.
